title: PII-VisBench: Evaluating Personally Identifiable Information Safety in Vision Language Models Along a Continuum of Visibility

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying subjects into four online visibility categories (high, medium, low, and zero) based on web search hit counts, and comparing the models' Refusal Rates (RR) and Conditional PII Disclosure Rates (cPDR) across these groups to measure differential privacy protection.

bias_targets.target: Demographic profiling and sensitive attribute inference
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting vision-language models to visually infer demographic and sensitive personal attributes (e.g., race, religion, gender, age, political views) from face images and measuring their refusal versus compliance rates, evaluating the models' propensity to engage in stereotyping and inappropriate visual inference.
